run_flashcard_server: run the fastapi flashcard display server on port 8000 using uvicorn
display_flashcards: post a flashcard set to the display endpoint to get interactive HTML
generate_flashcard_html: generate interactive HTML for flashcards using the flashcard_html function with title and cards
create_flashcard_set: create a flashcard set with a title, description, and list of front and back cards
view_flashcard_homepage: view the flashcard tool homepage with usage instructions and example JSON payload
